claims.value: 84 sample RAW (…_MS1..MS84.raw) + 40 fractionated pool RAW + 20 unfractionated pool RAW
claims.evidence: All 144 deposited RAW files claimed once; FASTA and .sne Spectronaut archive are not data files.
Danish Landrace crossbred pigs; PRIDE organism NEWT:9825.
Upper and lower trachea mucosa analysed; per-file upper/lower assignment not deposited, so the generic term is used.

Groups were control (6 pigs), swH1N1 (8), huH1N1 (8), but MS1-MS84 file numbers are not mapped to pigs, tissue or group anywhere in the deposit or paper; 84 files vs 22 pigs x 2 tissues = 44 so the file/sample relation is itself unknown.

Protocol: spectral-library pools of control and infected samples; file names poolCTR/poolSWINE/poolHUMAN/poolMEXI. Meaning of 'MEXI' is not stated; pool composition beyond 'control and infected' is inferred from names only.
Pools fractionated into 10 fractions by high pH fractionation.
